# devopser_workspace_run (Resource)

Runs a workspace on create (apply) and on destroy (destroy), like tfe_workspace_run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Applies the workspace when created and destroys its resources when this
# resource is destroyed. With manual_confirm = false the provider confirms the
# run itself; a destroy needs an infra:admin key from an organization admin.
resource "devopser_workspace_run" "network" {
  workspace_id = devopser_workspace.network.id

  apply {
    manual_confirm = false
    wait_for_run   = true
  }

  destroy {
    manual_confirm = false
    wait_for_run   = true
  }

  depends_on = [devopser_variable.region, devopser_workspace_settings.network]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String)

### Optional

- `apply` (Block, Optional) Queue an apply run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--apply))
- `destroy` (Block, Optional) Queue a destroy run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--destroy))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

Optional:

- `manual_confirm` (Boolean) false: the provider confirms the run itself with its token, as tfe does.
- `wait_for_run` (Boolean) Wait for the run to finish and fail if it errors (default true).
